papers.title: A Simulation-Driven Digital Workflow Integrating Bayesian Optimization for Early-Stage Process Design: A Methyl Acetate Production Case Study
papers.summary: Methyl acetate production via direct carbonylation of dimethyl ether and carbon monoxide involves strong nonlinear interactions among reactor operation, recycle structure, and energy consumption, making conventional simulation-based optimization computationally demanding. In this work, a data-driven framework integrating steady-state process simulation, surrogate modeling, and Bayesian optimization was developed for process intensification. A dataset of 2730 steady-state simulations was generated using a Python-based automated process simulation workflow and a structured design of experiments across the operating domain. Surrogate models were trained to predict carbon conversion yield (C-yield) and cost of specific energy consumption (C-SEC), with neural network-based models showing the best predictive performance and robustness. These models were integrated into a multi-objective Bayesian optimization framework to identify optimal operating regions. Results indicate that high C-yield (up to ~95%) can be achieved with reduced energy cost through lower recycle flow rates and compression demand. Pareto analysis revealed a nonlinear trade-off between C-yield and C-SEC, where further improvements near the conversion limit require disproportionately higher energy input. Validation against rigorous simulations showed deviations below 3% for C-yield and 10% for C-SEC.
papers.title_ja: ベイズ最適化を統合したシミュレーション駆動型デジタルワークフローによる初期段階のプロセス設計：酢酸メチル生産のケーススタディ
papers.summary_ja: 酢酸メチル生産プロセスにおいて、非線形な相互作用を考慮した計算コストの高い最適化問題を解決するため、定常状態シミュレーション、サロゲートモデル、ベイズ最適化を統合したデータ駆動型フレームワークを提案した。Pythonベースの自動化ワークフローと実験計画により2730件のシミュレーションデータを生成し、ニューラルネットワークベースのサロゲートモデルで炭素収率とエネルギーコストを高精度に予測した。このモデルを多目的ベイズ最適化に組み込むことで、リサイクル流量の低減を通じて高収率かつ低エネルギーコストな最適運転領域を特定した。厳密シミュレーションとの検証では、収率の誤差が3%未満、エネルギーコストの誤差が10%以内であることを確認し、実務的な有効性を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルとベイズ最適化の組み合わせが関心領域と一致

papers.title: Workload-Static Optical Circuit Switching For Scalable LLM Inference Decode
papers.summary: LLM inference decode executes fine-grained collectives whose latency directly limits per-user interactivity, yet scale-up fabrics are still built from electronic packet switches designed for training. We observe that, for a given model deployment and parallelization, the communication structure of decode is fixed, and propose workload-static optical circuit switching (OCS): circuits are configured once per deployment, co-designed with model parallelism and with topology-aware collective schedules that turn spare accelerator ports into fewer communication phases or higher bandwidth. We evaluate this design with GXNET, a graph-based workload emulator coupled to analytical and flit-level network models grounded in hardware measurements. In a 576-accelerator scale-up domain serving 5T-parameter MoE models with up to 5M tokens of context, all-OCS fabrics improve interactivity by up to 65% and energy efficiency by up to 119% over 4:1 oversubscribed packet-switched fabrics.
papers.title_ja: スケーラブルなLLM推論デコードのためのワークロード静的な光回路スイッチング
papers.summary_ja: 大規模言語モデル（LLM）の推論デコードフェーズにおける通信レイテンシを低減するため、モデルデプロイメントごとに固定される通信構造を利用した光回路スイッチング（OCS）手法を提案する。モデル並列化とトポロジー認識型コネクティブスケジューリングと協調設計することで、アクセラレータの空きポートを活用し通信フェーズを削減または帯域幅を向上させる。576アクセラレータ環境での評価により、パケットスイッチング方式と比較してインタラクティブ性が最大65%、エネルギー効率が最大119%向上することを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論の高速化と効率化に直結するハードウェア設計

papers.title: Stabilizing Neural Emulation of Spatiotemporal Physical Dynamics through Denoising Koopman Latent Dynamics
papers.summary: Koopman operator theory provides a principled framework for reduced-order modeling of nonlinear spatiotemporal dynamics through linear evolution in an observable space. In practice, however, learned finite-dimensional representations are typically approximately invariant, causing unresolved dynamics and accumulated closure errors. Recent approaches, inspired by the Mori-Zwanzig formalism, address these effects through deterministic memory or closure modeling, yet robust extrapolation beyond the training horizon remains challenging. Here, we propose KoopFlow, an efficient prediction-correction framework based on the key insight that finite-dimensional Koopman error accumulation can be reinterpreted as a progressive distributional degradation process. Accordingly, KoopFlow treats Koopman predictions as noisy intermediate estimates, which are then transported toward the target latent distribution through a generative model, thereby mitigating accumulated errors while retaining computational efficiency and temporal flexibility. Moreover, we reveal a non-monotonic relationship between Koopman spectral coherence and predictive accuracy. Experiments across diverse nonlinear dynamical systems demonstrate improved long-horizon prediction accuracy and stability over representative baselines, particularly beyond the training horizon.
papers.title_ja: ノイズ除去Koopman潜在ダイナミクスによる時空物理ダイナミクスのニューラルエミュレーションの安定化
papers.summary_ja: Koopman演算子理論に基づく縮約モデルにおいて、有限次元表現の閉包誤差が蓄積する問題を解決するため、予測-補正フレームワーク「KoopFlow」を提案する。Koopman予測をノイズの多い中間推定値とみなし、生成モデルを用いて目標潜在分布へ輸送することで、誤差を低減しつつ計算効率と時間的柔軟性を維持する。さらに、Koopmanスペクトル相干性と予測精度の間に非単調な関係があることを明らかにした。多様な非線形動的システムでの実験により、特に訓練期間を超えた長期予測において、既存ベースラインより高い精度と安定性が示された。
papers.relevance_reason: 縮約モデル・物理情報学習・長期予測の高速化に直結する手法

papers.title: A Compact Residual-Screened Local Reduced-Order Model for Diffuse-Domain Shape Optimization
papers.summary: We generalize the compact residual-screened local reduced-order model (CL-ROM) from Brinkman-penalized flow to shape optimization with the diffuse domain method (DDM). As with Brinkman penalization, DDM extends evolving-domain problems to a fixed rectangular domain, allowing one grid for discretization and directly compatible snapshots from different designs. Unlike Brinkman penalization, DDM uses a phase field to weight operators and sources and treats Dirichlet, Neumann and Robin conditions through diffuse boundary terms. The CL-ROM mechanism carries over: recent full-order and corrected solutions determine local reduced spaces, while residual screening, correction with retained factors and objective verification decide when a full-order solve is needed. We derive reduced operators, residuals and sensitivities for each diffuse model, using Galerkin projection for the symmetric problems and least-squares Petrov--Galerkin projection for nonlinear flow. For the symmetric problems we prove a local approximation estimate that admits inexact, corrected snapshots. In numerical tests of shape identification, drag minimization in Navier--Stokes channel flow and compliance minimization of a cantilever, CL-ROM uses reduced solutions for nearly all design updates, reproduces the full-order objectives with relative differences below $5\times10^{-6}$, and is $3.85$ to $7.65$ times faster than a full-order baseline that reuses factorizations as preconditioners.
papers.title_ja: 拡散領域形状最適化のためのコンパクトな残差スクリーニング付き局所縮約モデル
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、拡散領域法（DDM）を用いた形状最適化において、コンパクトな残差スクリーニング付き局所縮約モデル（CL-ROM）を適用する手法を提案する。DDMは可変領域問題を固定領域に拡張し、異なる設計間でのスナップショット互換性を確保する。残差スクリーニングと補正により、フルオーダー解算の必要性を判定し、対称問題では不正確な補正スナップショットを許容する局所近似誤差の理論的保証を導出する。数値実験では、フルオーダー解算に比べ3.85〜7.65倍の高速化を実現しつつ、目的関数の相対差を5e-6未満に抑える高精度を達成した。
papers.relevance_reason: 縮約モデルと形状最適化の高速化であり、ユーザーの関心と高度に一致

papers.title: Physics-Informed Functional Tucker Method with RKHS Factors for Sparse Spatiotemporal Reconstruction
papers.summary: Reconstructing physical dynamics from fixed sparse sensors and missing frames is a fundamental challenge in scientific research. Sparsity leaves large regions of the field unconstrained, making the inverse problem ill-posed: a model may fit the observed sensors while producing inaccurate off-sensor structures or unreliable predictions between support frames. To this end, we propose PhysFTM---a physics-informed functional Tucker model that parameterizes the Tucker mode factors in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (RKHSs) and incorporates PDE constraints through finite-difference residuals evaluated at off-sensor collocation points. These residuals provide additional physical information in regions without direct observational supervision. PhysFTM first reconstructs continuous spatial fields at support frames via an alternating minimization scheme, optimizing the Tucker core tensor and the RKHS-based factors separately. To enable missing-frame reconstruction, PhysFTM constructs a continuous trajectory in Tucker-core space, which is decoded by the learned spatial RKHS-FTM representation to recover the full spatiotemporal field. Experiments on Allen--Cahn, Navier--Stokes, three-dimensional Heat equations, and a three-dimensional gridded Copernicus ocean reanalysis demonstrate accurate 2D/3D reconstruction under two missing-frame protocols. Code is available at https://github.com/liusirzzz/PhysFTM.
papers.title_ja: RKHS因子を用いた物理情報機能Tucker法によるスパース時空間再構成
papers.summary_ja: 固定されたスパースなセンサーデータと欠損フレームから物理的ダイナミクスを再構成する課題に対し、物理情報機能Tuckerモデル（PhysFTM）を提案する。本手法はTucker分解のモード因子を再生核ヒルベルト空間（RKHS）でパラメータ化し、センサーのない領域でのPDE制約を有限差分残差として組み込むことで、逆問題の不適切性を緩和する。まず交互最小化法により支持フレームでの連続空間場を再構成し、次にTuckerコア空間内の連続軌道を通じて欠損フレームの再構成を実現する。Allen-Cahn方程式やNavier-Stokes方程式、3次元海洋再解析データを用いた実験において、高精度な2D/3D再構成能力を実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報ニューラルネットとサロゲートモデルの核心技術に該当

papers.title: Multi-layer Indexer: Overlapping Selection and Attention in DeepSeek Sparse Attention
papers.summary: Sparse attention cuts the cost of long-context inference by making the attention matrix sparse: each query attends only a subset of the sequence, chosen by a fixed pattern or, in recent production LLMs, learned per query. In DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA), the attention of DeepSeek-V3.2 and the GLM-5 family, every layer is preceded by a lightning indexer that scores the whole cache and keeps the k=2048 highest-scoring tokens for the layer to attend. At long context this indexer scan, not the sparse attention it feeds, is where the decode time goes. But adjacent layers select nearly the same tokens, so a layer can attend the selection of the previous indexer layer instead of its own. This removes the dependency: each indexer then runs concurrently with the attention of its layer. The resulting Multi-layer Indexer (MLI) needs no retraining and no new weights. Its default realization changes no kernel, running inside SGLang's production decode graph; an optional fused decode kernel accelerates it further on DeepSeek-V3.2. MLI composes with IndexCache (the cross-layer reuse GLM-5.2 ships as IndexShare): IndexCache drops the indexer from some layers, and MLI hides the scan on the rest. We serve DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5 under IndexCache's protocol at retentions 1/2 to 1/32 (the fraction of layers that keep an indexer) and contexts 10K to 195K. At equal retention the composition decodes faster than IndexCache: up to 14.5% faster on DeepSeek-V3.2 and 9.8% on GLM-5 at 1/2, and 7.9% and 5.1% at 1/4, largest where IndexCache keeps the most indexers and growing with context. At retention 1/r it is faster still than IndexCache at 1/(2r) while keeping twice the fresh selections: at 128K it reaches 1.32x the unmodified model's decode throughput at 1/4, above IndexCache's 1.28x at 1/8. Its LongBench, RULER and LongBench v2 accuracy stays within a few percentage points of IndexCache's.
papers.title_ja: マルチレイヤーインデクサー：DeepSeekスパースアテンションにおける重複選択とアテンション
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、DeepSeek-V3.2やGLM-5などのLLMにおける長文脈推論のボトルネックであるインデクサーのスキャン時間を削減する手法「マルチレイヤーインデクサー（MLI）」を提案する。隣接レイヤーがほぼ同じトークンを選択する特性を利用し、各レイヤーが自身のインデクサーではなく前段の選択結果を用いることで、インデクサー処理とアテンション計算を並列化し、依存関係を解消する。再学習や新しい重みの追加を必要とせず、既存のプロダクション環境（SGLang）に統合可能である。IndexCacheとの組み合わせにより、同等の精度を維持しつつ、最大14.5%のデコード速度向上や、未修正モデル比1.32倍のスループット向上を実現した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論高速化・スパースアテンション最適化の核心手法

papers.title: FlagRot: Selective Rotation for Low-Bit KV Caches
papers.summary: Long-context inference is bound by the KV cache, which 2-bit codes could shrink about sixfold if their error stays in check. The usual remedy rotates keys before quantizing, assuming rotation always helps. However, we observe that it does not: rotation flattens a spiky piece of a key but can give a flat one a new peak, and both coexist within one key. We therefore propose FlagRot, which stores each 32-channel piece rotated or as is, whichever has the smaller calibrated attention error, and rotates the query instead when reading. We further show that how often to decide follows the quantization axis: per-channel caches such as KIVI need one decision per head, at no write cost, while per-token caches decide per key, with the choice stored in existing sign bits. At 2.5 bits per value, FlagRot lowers the twelve-model KL divergence of KIVI from 18.7 to 12.4 x 10^-3, below RotateKV on 9 of 12 models. Served as a vLLM plugin, it raises RULER at 128k tokens by +2.9 points and the LongBench v1 mean by +0.4 to +1.9 points on the three of four models where 2-bit KIVI loses accuracy. It also lowers the error of 4-bit integer and FP4 caches.
papers.title_ja: FlagRot: 低ビットKVキャッシュのための選択的回転
papers.summary_ja: 長文脈推論におけるKVキャッシュの量子化誤差を低減する手法FlagRotを提案する。従来の一律なキー回転では誤差が増大するケースがあるため、32チャネル単位で回転有無を注意誤差に基づき選択し、読み出し時にクエリ側を回転させる。2.5ビット量子化において既存手法KIVIやRotateKVを上回る精度を達成し、vLLMプラグインとして実装することで128kトークン級の長文脈ベンチマーク（RULER, LongBench）で性能を向上させる。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM推論高速化・量子化・RAG効率化の核心技術

papers.title: Dory1.0-4B: A Looped Normalized-GPT
papers.summary: We introduce Dory1.0-4B, a 4-billion-parameter looped (latent-recurrent) language model with elastic depth: a single checkpoint serves different inference compute budgets. Dory1.0-4B is built on a normalized Transformer (nGPT) backbone with interleaved sliding-window and full-attention layers, organized into an input block, a shared recurrent block, and an output block. At inference, the recurrent block can be applied a variable number of times. We pre-trained Dory1.0-4B on 6 trillion tokens. The first 4.5 trillion tokens were trained in NVFP4, and additional pre-training then extended the context length to 256K tokens. Next, we post-trained the model using Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), with a difficulty-aware loop curriculum that routes harder prompts to deeper loops. Increasing the loop count improves accuracy, with the largest gains on coding, agentic, and long-context benchmarks. With two or more loops, Dory1.0-4B outperforms larger models such as Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma 4 12B, and Gemma 4 26B-A4B on average across 12 benchmarks. Looping also makes Dory1.0-4B more token-efficient on agentic benchmarks: with four loops, it generates 1.3-2.5x fewer tokens than with one loop, as the extra computation is spent in latent space rather than on longer outputs. To reduce memory during looping, Dory1.0-4B caches keys and values only from the last loop, keeping its KV-cache footprint equal to that of a non-looped model at any loop count while retaining most of the accuracy gains. We open-source the BF16, MXFP8, NVFP4, and GGUF quantized checkpoints.
papers.title_ja: Dory1.0-4B: ループ型正規化GPT
papers.summary_ja: Dory1.0-4Bは、推論時の計算予算に応じて深さを柔軟に変えられる「ループ型（潜在再帰型）」LLMである。単一のチェックポイントで異なる計算量に対応し、推論時に再帰ブロックを繰り返し適用することで精度を向上させる。特にコーディングやエージェントタスク、長文脈処理において、より大きなモデル（Qwen3.5-9Bなど）を上回る性能を発揮する。また、KVキャッシュのメモリ効率を維持しつつ、トークン生成数を削減するトークン効率の改善も実現している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの推論高速化・効率化・量子化に直結する手法

papers.title: A Modular Open-Source Python Framework for Small Satellite Attitude Determination and Control
papers.summary: Advanced attitude determination and control (ADCS) techniques can be difficult for small satellite teams to adopt: tightly coupled implementations require substantial code changes to evaluate different actuators, sensors, orbits, mission goals, and control laws. Existing tools often emphasize orbit mechanics or flight software rather than closed-loop ADCS. This paper presents an open-source, modular ADCS framework in pure Python for rapid development, repeatable testing, and flight-oriented integration across heterogeneous spacecraft. The package supports torque- and command-level control, bound-respecting allocation, and full- and reduced-attitude objectives. Interchangeable estimation, control, planning, and actuator/sensor modules are reconfigured through configuration changes. Integrated simulation includes attitude and orbit propagation, sensor and actuator bias and noise, and environmental disturbances. An actuator-aware planner supports underactuated architectures, while hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) capability enables testing on mission-representative computers. Case studies include a 3U CubeSat with three magnetorquers and one reaction wheel, a magnetorquer-only 1U, and a 6U with three reaction wheels and thrusters. These demonstrate actuator and sensor failures, full- and reduced-attitude goals, and momentum management. HIL testing on a Raspberry Pi uses the same package. Adapting a published control law to a new actuator configuration requires fewer than five lines of configuration changes. The framework underpins flight software for an Earth-observing CubeSat with visible and long-wave infrared imagers, three magnetorquers, and one reaction wheel, without star trackers or propulsion.
papers.title_ja: 小型衛星の姿勢決定・制御のためのモジュール型オープンソースPythonフレームワーク
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、小型衛星チームが複雑な姿勢決定・制御（ADCS）手法を容易に導入・評価できる純Python製のオープンソースフレームワークを提案する。推定・制御・アクチュエータ・センサの各モジュールを設定ファイルで柔軟に再構成可能であり、トルクレベルおよびコマンドレベルの制御、境界制約付き配分、縮約姿勢目標などをサポートする。統合シミュレーションでは姿勢・軌道伝播、ノイズ・バイアス、環境擾乱を考慮し、Raspberry Pi によるハードウェアインザループ（HIL）テストも可能である。3U CubeSat などのケーススタディを通じて、アクチュエータ故障時の挙動や、既存制御則の新構成への適用が5行未満の設定変更で完了することを示し、実務的な開発効率の向上を実証している。
papers.relevance_reason: 軌道力学・宇宙機制御とML/Python実装の交差点で、実務応用性が高い

papers.title: Disruption limits around triaxial bodies and implications for ring-bearing minor bodies
papers.summary: The classical Roche limit is often used as a boundary between ring-dominated and satellite-dominated regions, although it is derived for a self-gravitating fluid satellite orbiting a spherical primary. This assumption is poorly suited to ring-bearing minor bodies, which are often triaxial. Here, we compute the equilibrium figures and disruption limits of inviscid fluid satellites orbiting triaxial primaries, modelling their gravity fields through J2 and C22. The primary's oblateness and equatorial asymmetry shifts the disruption limit outward relative to the classical Roche limit, with C22 dominating the correction at sufficiently high values, which require highly oblate primaries. The disruption location also depends on the primary's orientation, defining a radial disruption region rather than a single limit in non-double-synchronous systems. Increasing orbital inclination shifts the limit inward, significantly so only at high inclinations. Symbolic regression provides an empirical expression for the disruption limit around triaxial primaries, which we apply to ring-bearing minor bodies. The correction is most relevant for Haumea and Chariklo, whereas the rings of Chiron and Quaoar located beyond the classical Roche limit remain outside the disruption region for realistic particle densities. This indicates that treating the disruption limit as a strict boundary between ring-dominated and satellite-dominated regions is an oversimplification, since the long-term survival of a ring also depends on collisional evolution, particle properties, and resonant confinement driven by the primary's non-axisymmetric gravity field.
papers.title_ja: 三軸天体周囲の破壊限界と環を持つ小天体への含意
papers.summary_ja: 従来のロッシュ限界は球状主天体を前提としており、三軸形状を持つ環を持つ小天体には不向きである。本研究では、J2とC22による重力場をモデル化し、三軸主天体周囲の流体衛星の破壊限界を計算した。主天体の扁平度や非対称性により破壊限界は外側にシフトし、特にC22が支配的になる場合がある。また、軌道傾斜角や主天体の向きによって破壊領域が単一の限界ではなく放射状の領域として定義されることを示した。シンボリック回帰を用いて経験式を導出し、ハウメアやカリクローなど実際の小天体への適用性を検証した。
papers.relevance_reason: 軌道力学・小天体・破壊限界の理論的深化であり、ユーザーの関心に直結

papers.title: A wider state, not wider arithmetic, for single-precision time integration
papers.summary: Single precision (FP32) halves the memory and data movement of double precision (FP64), and on accelerators is often several times faster. Its rounding errors are harmless except in the stored state. A modified equation for Runge-Kutta methods in Shu-Osher form and linear multistep methods separates the rounding of the stored state, a forcing proportional to $1/\Delta t$, from truncation and from right-hand-side rounding, which sets a $\Delta t$-independent floor. We bound this forcing for strong-stability-preserving schemes and identify two mechanisms that keep its sign fixed, so it accumulates as a bias: past a turnaround step, refining the step increases the error, in FP64 as in FP32. For a model oscillator the analysis predicts the floor and the FP32-to-FP64 ratios of turnaround step and minimum error within 30%. Our remedy needs no FP64 arithmetic: each state variable is stored as the unevaluated sum of two FP32 numbers, updated with error-free transformations, while every right-hand-side evaluation stays in FP32. Unlike compensated summation, it needs no rewriting of the scheme. In model problems from geophysical flow, mechanical dynamics and celestial mechanics, with five Runge-Kutta and multistep schemes, it restores design-order convergence to the floor. In large-eddy simulations of a high-lift airplane wing on three refined grids, up to 544 million cells, with time steps $\Delta t$, $\Delta t/2$ and $\Delta t/4$, FP32 overpredicts the lift by 2.1, 4.5 and 7.7%, while the two-float lift agrees with FP64 within 0.3% on every grid, and on graphics processing units the production solver runs 1.6 to 2.7 times faster than FP64.
papers.title_ja: 単精度時間積分における、演算幅の拡大ではなく状態の拡張
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、単精度（FP32）での数値積分における丸め誤差が蓄積する問題に対し、状態変数を2つのFP32数値の未評価和として保存する手法を提案する。この手法は右辺の評価をFP32のまま行いながら、誤差のバイアス蓄積を防ぎ、設計通りの収束性を回復させる。天体力学や気象流体力学などのモデル問題で有効性を示し、大規模LESではFP64と同等の精度を維持しつつ、GPU上で1.6〜2.7倍の高速化を実現した。
papers.relevance_reason: 天体力学・軌道計算の高速化と精度維持に直結する手法

papers.title: Ground-Wing: A Parametric 3D Wing-in-Ground-Effect Dataset for Benchmarking Neural Surrogate Models
papers.summary: This paper presents a CFD dataset of a highly parametrized 3D wing operating in ground effect, designed for benchmarking neural surrogate models for aerodynamic prediction, using a wing shape and flow conditions typically encountered in motorsport applications. The dataset comprises 770 RANS simulations of 194 unique wing configurations, sampled across 27 airfoil profile variants and 4 distances from the ground, spanning variations in wing sweep, chord, taper, angle of attack, and tip twist. Six neural network architectures representing distinct paradigms --- convolutional (DoMINO), graph-based (X-MeshGraphNet), transformer-based (AB-UPT, GeoTransolver, GAOT), and JEPA-based (AeroJEPA) --- are evaluated on their ability to predict surface pressure coefficient and wall shear stress distributions, from which integral drag and lift coefficients are recovered. The dataset is intended to be used as a challenging benchmark for surrogate CFD models, due to the uniqueness of the ground effect being absent from other wing and airfoil datasets.
papers.title_ja: Ground-Wing: ニューラルサロゲートモデルのベンチマークのためのパラメトリック3D接地効果翼データセット
papers.summary_ja: モータースポーツ応用を想定した3D接地効果翼のCFDシミュレーションデータセットを提案し、ニューラルサロゲートモデルの性能評価を行う。770件のRANSシミュレーションからなるデータを用い、CNN、グラフベース、Transformer、JEPAなど6つの異なるアーキテクチャを比較評価した。表面圧力係数や壁面せん断応力の予測精度を基準に、積分された抗力・揚力係数の再現性を検証している。接地効果という既存データセットにない特性を含むため、サロゲートモデルのベンチマークとして有用である。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルとベンチマーク設計の両方に直接関連

papers.title: Surrogate Models for Stochastic Al-Cu Phase-Field Solidification
papers.summary: Phase-field models resolve microstructural evolution during rapid alloy solidification, but their computational cost limits long trajectories, stochastic ensembles, and studies across process conditions. We present a variance-preserving denoising diffusion bridge model (VP-DDBM) for state-conditioned prediction of two-dimensional Al-Cu solidification. Given the current phase, concentration, and prescribed temperature fields, the model predicts the subsequent state and is applied autoregressively. Across two held-out thermal gradients, VP-DDBM produces lower long-horizon errors than deterministic U-Net and SI-ConvNeXt baselines in domain-mean phase, domain-mean Cu concentration, and leading-tip position. It also retains fine dendritic structure over long rollouts, whereas the deterministic U-Net progressively smooths the morphology. VP-DDBM predicts the phase and concentration evolution approximately $73\times$ faster than the phase-field solver, showing potential for faster process-condition screening and ensemble-based microstructure studies.
papers.title_ja: 確率的Al-Cu相場凝固のためのサロゲートモデル
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、計算コストの高いAl-Cu合金の相場凝固シミュレーションを高速化するため、分散保持型ノイズ除去拡散ブリッジモデル（VP-DDBM）を提案する。現在の状態と温度場から将来の状態を自己回帰的に予測し、決定論的なU-NetやSI-ConvNeXtと比較した。結果、長期的な予測誤差が低く、デンドライト構造をより忠実に再現しつつ、元のソルバー比で約73倍の高速化を実現した。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理現象のサロゲートモデル化と高速化という関心に強く合致

papers.title: De Rham cohomological architectures for PINNs and PDEs with topological holes
papers.summary: We attempt to alleviate failure modes of classical physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) in scenarios of topological pathologies corresponding to punctures, holes, poles, and voids by introducing de Rham cohomological augmentations, or Hodge-de Rham PINNs. Vanilla PINNs often encounter pitfalls in hole-based settings due to discontinuous interfaces, nonzero closed path integration, path dependence, correspondence to exact forms via the exterior derivative, etc., therefore we absolve traditional failures via parameterizing a 1-form by the Hodge-Morrey-Friedrichs (HMF) decomposition for manifolds with boundary, drawing a connection to de Rham cohomology such as through the HMF isomorphism theorem. 1-forms can act as representations of scalar-valued PDE solutions through integral operator mappings. We propose performing a PINN-based loss on the parameterized 1-form through an associated PDE, which subsequently solves the potential-based PINN problem and moreover remedies the failures of vanilla PINNs via the Sobolev-regular operator under a Fr\'echet differentiation interconnection. The operator relationship often has a nontrivial closed-form and often requires integration or a case-by-case analysis, which we address thoroughly in our experiments. When an integrability condition is not met on our losses, we can equip exhaustion functions to train the networks. We demonstrate our methods on the Aharonov-Bohm effect, which, to our understanding, is largely nonexistent in PINN literature. We develop theoretical guarantees of our methods and demonstrate our pathological safeguards on a broad selection of topologically-adverse problems, including scenarios of inexact forms, and those of nontrivial harmonics and coexact terms.
papers.title_ja: PINNおよびトポロジー的穴を持つPDEのためのde Rhamコホモロジー的アーキテクチャ
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、穴や欠陥を持つトポロジー的状況で従来の物理情報ニューラルネット（PINN）が失敗する問題を解決するため、de RhamコホモロジーとHodge-Morrey-Friedrichs分解を導入した新しいアーキテクチャを提案する。スカラー値のPDE解を1-形式として表現し、積分演算子を通じて損失関数を設計することで、経路依存性や不連続界面などの問題に対処する。Aharonov-Bohm効果などのトポロジー的に困難な問題において、従来のPINNの欠陥を補正し、理論的保証とともにその有効性を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: PINNとトポロジー的PDE解決の高度な手法であり、サロゲートモデルの応用範囲拡大に直結する

papers.title: From Forecasting to Feedback: Evaluating Learned Dynamics for Tokamak Control
papers.summary: Learned temporal models are moving beyond offline forecasting toward interactive environments for decision making, yet logged-trajectory accuracy need not predict closed-loop behavior under policies optimized in the learned model. This forecasting-control gap matters in tokamak magnetic control, where coupled plasma-circuit dynamics and actuator constraints can amplify errors through feedback. Using a calibrated free-boundary Grad-Shafranov solver, we collect four datasets in a 2x2 design over physics-parameter and current-reference coverage. At matched budgets of 500, 1k, 3k, and 5k rollouts, we train 16 action-conditioned Transformers; PPO policies optimized in the 5k surrogates are then evaluated without adaptation on six reference-solver conditions. Only joint-coverage D4 shows monotonically decreasing cross-condition mean error, whereas D1 improves in distribution but degrades out of distribution. Binary completion masks substantial closed-loop differences: D2-D4 each complete 83.3% of conditions, but reach on average 99.0%, 94.7%, and 90.5% of the evaluation horizon, while their worst conditions reach 94.2%, 68.2%, and 43.2%. Policies trained with action noise complete 5/24 matched conditions, compared with 19/24 under nominal training, and have a lower mean horizon-capped episode length. Based on one trained policy per configuration and one evaluation realization per condition, the results support combining prediction error, episode completion, condition-level duration, and tracking quality.
papers.title_ja: 予測からフィードバックへ：トカマック制御における学習済みダイナミクスの評価
papers.summary_ja: トカマックの磁気制御において、学習された時間系列モデル（サロゲート）を用いたオフライン予測精度と、クローズドループ制御時の実際の性能との乖離を評価する。物理パラメータと電流参照の組み合わせによる4つのデータセットを用い、アクション条件付きTransformerを訓練し、PPOポリシーを最適化・評価した。結果、予測誤差だけでなく、エピソード完了率や条件ごとの持続時間、追従品質を総合的に評価することが重要であることが示された。特に、分布外データでの性能劣化や、アクションノイズの影響を定量的に分析し、実用的な制御設計への指針を提示している。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルと強化学習の組み合わせ、および評価手法の観点で高関連。

papers.title: Integrating Machine Learning and Uncertainty Quantification for Real-Time Decision-Making in Digital Twins: A System-Centric Review and Perspective
papers.summary: Digital Twins are evolving from passive virtual representations into closed-loop systems that continuously synchronize with physical assets and drive real-time decisions. Yet predictive modeling, machine learning (ML), uncertainty quantification (UQ), and decision-making have been studied as separate capabilities, leaving limited understanding of their integration and maintenance during online operation. This narrative review, scoped by the functional requirements of real-time decision-making rather than by Digital Twin terminology alone, examines how such decisions are generated and sustained in engineering Digital Twins. We first examine foundational decision-making architectures and representative engineering applications, followed by methods that address their limitations across the decision loop. We identify optimization-based, policy-based, and knowledge-based approaches as the major pathways from virtual representation to action. Across them, ML plays three roles in decision-making: enabling efficient surrogate modeling, transforming heterogeneous physical feedback into decision-relevant information, and accelerating or directly generating decisions. UQ supports uncertainty-aware decisions and model adaptation, while continual validation, drift detection, and adaptation help maintain reliable operation as the physical system evolves. Together, these findings underscore the need for a shift from a model-centric to a system-centric perspective on Digital Twins, where its performance depends on the interactions with sensing, state estimation, computation, decision-making, and adaptation rather than on their standalone performance. Therefore, future research should shift from isolated algorithm development toward system-level co-design, scalable decision-making, and approaches to design, and data-efficient continual adaptation and validation for AI-enabled autonomous systems.
papers.title_ja: デジタルツインにおけるリアルタイム意思決定のための機械学習と不確実性定量化の統合：システム中心のレビューと展望
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、デジタルツインにおけるリアルタイム意思決定において、機械学習（ML）と不確実性定量化（UQ）を統合的に扱うためのシステム中心的なレビューを行う。MLはサロゲートモデルによる高速化、物理フィードバックの意思決定向け変換、および意思決定の生成・加速という3つの役割を果たすことを指摘する。また、UQは不確実性を考慮した意思決定とモデル適応を支援し、継続的な検証やドリフト検出を通じて物理システムの変化に伴う信頼性を維持する。最終的に、個別アルゴリズムの開発から、センシング・状態推定・計算・意思決定・適応の相互作用を重視するシステムレベルのコデザインへの転換が不可欠であると提言する。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルとUQによるリアルタイム最適化・意思決定の統合が関心と一致

papers.title: Spin Spherical Fourier Neural Operators: Efficient Equivariant Learning for Vector and Spin Fields on the Sphere
papers.summary: Many fields of physical interest on the sphere, such as wind, the polarisation of the cosmic microwave background and the shear of weak gravitational lensing, are spin fields, whose values change phase when the local frame rotates. We extend spherical Fourier neural operators (SFNOs) to fields of any spin, through lifted spherical convolutions that are exactly rotationally equivariant. Lifting spin fields to Mackey functions on the rotation group provides the conceptual framework, while computation is performed exactly and efficiently through their harmonic representation and by appealing to sampling theorems on the sphere and rotation group. We construct spin SFNOs (S$^2$FNOs) from these building blocks. We demonstrate empirically that rotational equivariance holds to machine precision for these layers. We achieve state-of-the-art performance on existing benchmarks, and introduce new benchmarks on which spin-aware models outperform their scalar counterparts.
papers.title_ja: スピン球面フーリエニューラルオペレータ：球面上のベクトル場およびスピン場に対する効率的な等変学習
papers.summary_ja: 球面上のスピン場（風や宇宙マイクロ波背景放射の偏光など）を対象に、回転等変性を厳密に保つ球面フーリエニューラルオペレータ（SFNO）の拡張手法を提案する。回転群上のマッキー関数へのリフトと調和表現を用いることで、計算効率と理論的厳密性を両立させた。既存ベンチマークで最先端性能を達成し、スピン認識モデルがスカラーモデルを上回る新規ベンチマークも導入した。
papers.relevance_reason: ニューラルオペレータと物理情報学習の高度な応用であり、手法の汎用性が高い

papers.title: Solving the Nonlinear Westervelt Equation in Ultrasound Propagation Using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.summary: Modeling the nonlinear acoustic wave propagation in biological tissues needs accuracy, especially in ultrasound imaging and therapeutic applications. The 1D Westervelt equation, \( p_{xx} - p_{tt} + \gamma\, p_{ttt} + \eta\,(p^{2})_{tt}=0, \) could be used to describe a finite-amplitude ultrasound propagation in these tissues. This equation accounts for nonlinearity, \(\eta\), and attenuation, \(\gamma\). To solve this equation, we observe that traditional solvers may struggle to do so correctly. This is due to the difficulties arising from the nonlinear nature of the equation. We solve the equation by defining three synthetic cases - linear (\(\eta=0.001\), \(\gamma=10^{-6}\)), shock-dominated (\(\eta=0.02\), \(\gamma=10^{-6}\)), and dissipation-dominated (\(\eta=0.01\), \(\gamma=5\times10^{-4}\)) - and using Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) to showcase the solution. A sinusoidal activation function is used to capture the oscillatory behavior of the problem. The results of our study, with PDE residual converging to at least \(10^{-6}\), boundary condition loss to \(10^{-5}\), and the PINN loss converging to \(10^{-5}\) for each case at \(30,000\) epochs, show that \(\gamma\) scales the rate of amplitude decay, while \(\eta\) governs frequency-dependent phase speeds.
papers.title_ja: 物理情報ニューラルネットワークを用いた超音波伝播における非線形Westervelt方程式の解法
papers.summary_ja: 生物組織内の非線形音波伝播を記述するWestervelt方程式を、物理情報ニューラルネットワーク（PINN）を用いて解く手法を提案する。従来のソルバーが苦手とする非線形性を扱い、正弦波活性化関数により振動挙動を捉える。線形、衝撃支配、減衰支配の3つの合成ケースで検証し、PDE残差が10^-6以下に収束することを示した。減衰係数γが振幅減衰率を、非線形係数ηが周波数依存位相速度を支配することを定量的に確認した。
papers.relevance_reason: PINNというユーザー関心の高い手法で物理方程式を解く実例であり、サロゲートモデルに近い価値がある。

papers.title: Adaptive data-driven reduced-order models for reciprocal MIMO port-Hamiltonian dynamical systems
papers.summary: Port-Hamiltonian (pH) systems provide a general framework for modeling a broad class of physical dynamical systems, including systems with dissipation. Constructing accurate and robust data-driven reduced-order models for general pH systems is challenging. In this work, we focus on an important subclass of pH systems satisfying reciprocity, a property arising naturally in a variety of models. Rather than seeking to preserve the full pH structure, we exploit the additional symmetry provided by reciprocity to develop an efficient data-driven reduced-order modeling approach. We show that every minimal realization of a reciprocal system is self-adjoint with respect to a generally indefinite inner product and can, up to a similarity transformation preserving the pH structure, be represented in a Krein space with a signature inner product. This observation motivates a Galerkin projection onto a tangential rational Krylov subspace with respect to the corresponding indefinite inner product. Although the resulting projection involves full-order state solutions and the unknown inner product, we show that its reduced mass and stiffness matrices can be constructed directly from transfer-function data through a Loewner formulation. We then propose a greedy data-driven procedure that adaptively selects both interpolation frequencies and tangential directions. At every iteration, the frequency is chosen according to the largest transfer-function approximation error, while the tangential direction is selected from a dominant singular direction of the corresponding matrix-valued residual. Numerical experiments for wave propagation in lossy media demonstrate improved approximation efficiency compared with block adaptive interpolation. We further apply the method to spectral mass gauging of a three-dimensional propellant tank to provide an accurate estimate of the tank volume through Weyl's law.
papers.title_ja: 相互性を持つMIMOポート・ハミルトニアン動的システムのための適応型データ駆動型縮約モデル
papers.summary_ja: 相互性を満たすポート・ハミルトニアン系を対象に、データ駆動型の縮約モデル構築手法を提案する。不確定内積を持つクレイン空間におけるガレルキン射影を用い、伝達関数データからLoewner定式化を通じて縮約質量・剛性行列を直接構築する。周波数と接線方向を誤差に基づいて適応的に選択する貪欲法により、ブロック適応補間より高い近似効率を実現した。損失媒体中の波伝播や推進剤タンクの体積推定への適用例を示し、物理系への有効性を検証している。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報を持つ縮約モデルとデータ駆動最適化の組み合わせであり、関心領域に直結する。

papers.title: Mixture of Wide Experts: Sparse Routing for Interpretable Native Coordinates
papers.summary: Language models often spread a concept across many internal dimensions, making their features difficult to interpret. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) recover clearer features after training. We ask whether models can instead learn interpretable output coordinates directly. We introduce Mixture of Wide Experts (MoWE), a sparse feed-forward layer in which selected experts read the full representation but write to fixed, disjoint output coordinates. On a controlled task with known hidden causes, this design preserves predictive performance while localizing causes more clearly than dense and standard mixture-of-experts (MoE) models. At approximately matched compute, we train two 19-layer runs of each architecture for 10 billion tokens. MoWE achieves evaluation cross-entropy 2.417 versus 2.452 for dense, while standard MoE reaches 2.22. We measure native-coordinate readability by asking a language-model judge to describe each coordinate from passages where it is strongly active and test that description on new passages. Correcting for descriptions that also fit other coordinates gives a specificity score of 0.523 for MoWE, 0.375 for dense, and 0.268 for standard MoE. TopK SAEs trained on the same FFN updates score 0.489 for dense and 0.556 for MoWE, making native MoWE comparable to the dense SAE. In the first case study, we identify a four-coordinate causal path supporting the model's prediction of degrees after the prompt A right angle is 90. We then copy seven angle-related coordinate values into the model as it processes A rectangle has four, changing its next-token prediction from sides to degrees. In the second, one fixed coordinate set detects hazardous requests and another steers the next token toward refusal. These examples show that MoWE combines sparse conditional computation with coordinates that can be identified and reused directly.
papers.title_ja: 広域エキスパートの混合：解釈可能なネイティブ座標のためのスパースルーティング
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、LLMの内部表現を解釈可能な固定座標に直接学習させるための新しいアーキテクチャ「Mixture of Wide Experts (MoWE)」を提案する。MoWEは、選択されたエキスパートが完全な表現を読み取り、互いに排他的な固定出力座標に書き込むことで、従来のMixture-of-Experts (MoE) やスパースオートエンコーダ (SAE) と比較して、原因の局所化と解釈可能性を向上させる。100億トークンでの訓練実験では、MoWEは高密度モデルより低いクロスエントロピー（2.417 vs 2.452）を達成し、標準MoE（2.22）に近い性能を示しつつ、座標の特定性スコア（0.523）で高密度モデル（0.375）や標準MoE（0.268）を上回った。さらに、角度の予測や有害リクエストの検出といったケーススタディを通じて、特定座標の値を書き換えることでモデルの出力を制御できることを実証し、スパース計算と解釈可能な座標系を統合する手法として有効性を示している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの効率化（スパース計算）と解釈可能性・制御の両立という重要な課題を扱い、実務応用性が高い。

papers.title: Stress-Testing the Robustness of LLM-Based Causal Inference
papers.summary: Why do some of the world's most powerful Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems still struggle to reason about cause and effect? Causal discovery, the ability to discern the underlying drivers of a system, is fundamental to scientific inquiry and has traditionally relied on structured data and statistical methods. Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have been explored as an alternative paradigm for causal inference, leveraging their broad knowledge and reasoning capabilities. Yet, despite their linguistic fluency, LLMs often rely on surface-level pattern recognition rather than genuine causal logic. While it is known that LLMs stumble in this domain, we lack a precise map of where, why, and how significantly these failures occur. In this paper, we propose a systematic stress-test framework across six critical dimensions: model scale, causal graph complexity, prompting strategy, metadata quality, data quality, and sensitivity to uncertainty. Our findings reveal a significant "optimism bias" in LLMs; models consistently overestimate causal links, leading to low precision across the board. Furthermore, we demonstrate that traditional evaluation metrics can be deceptive: while reasoning-heavy models lead in performance, the highest scores often occur when uncertainty in inference is overlooked. Once uncertainty is integrated into the evaluation, performance drops, providing a more honest reflection of causal reliability. We also find that, while scaling model size improves outcomes, these gains are fragile; performance degrades sharply as the quality of metadata decreases. This work serves as a practical guide to the blind spots of LLMs, offering a clear-eyed assessment of when these tools can be integrated into a causal discovery pipeline and when they are likely to lead researchers astray.
papers.title_ja: LLMベースの因果推論の頑健性に関するストレステスト
papers.summary_ja: 大規模言語モデル（LLM）の因果推論能力を、モデル規模やグラフ複雑度、プロンプト戦略など6つの次元から体系的に評価するフレームワークを提案する。LLMには因果関係を見積もりすぎる「楽観バイアス」が存在し、精度が低いことが明らかになった。また、不確実性を考慮した評価を行うと、従来の指標では過大評価されていた性能が低下し、より現実的な信頼性が示される。本研究は、LLMを因果発見パイプラインに統合する際の盲点を示し、実務的なガイドラインを提供する。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの推論特性と評価手法の改善に直結し、実務応用の信頼性評価に有用

papers.title: Unsatz: Evaluating Scientific Discovery Without a Given Ansatz
papers.summary: Before a scientist fits any parameter, they must decide what the model contains: which quantities exist, which are hidden, how they interact, and how they are measured. Physicists call such a trial form an ansatz. Benchmarks for automated equation discovery mostly supply it, by fixing the variables, a library of candidate terms, or a law to be modified. We introduce Unsatz, a benchmark in which an LLM agent must construct the ansatz itself. Each task is a simulated system, generated from a private seed as a program in a small modeling language: ordinary, delay, or partial differential equations, discrete maps, static and causal models, or stochastic processes, possibly with hidden states, distorted sensors, and uninformative measurement channels. The agent buys experiments within a budget, writes candidate programs in the same language, obtains their coefficients from the benchmark's fitter, and is scored only on how its final program predicts experiments it never saw: conditions outside the range it could explore, interventions, and longer runs. Across 80 systems in 20 domains, nine language models solve between 21% and 60%. On 44 of these systems, classical equation-discovery methods almost never succeed, although the same data usually suffice once the true equations are given with unknown coefficients; the difficulty lies in finding the structure, not in estimating it. Because mechanisms recur across systems, we also give agents the program they discovered for a related system; it helped only when the new system shared the mechanism and the first investigation had succeeded. Stronger agents make fewer unscientific errors; beyond these, agents find which variables a system has but not how they act, and prefer revisions that lower the training error to revisions that predict better.
papers.title_ja: Unsatz: 仮定なしの科学的発見の評価
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、LLMエージェントがモデルの構造（アンザッツ）を自ら構築し、実験予算内で仮説を検証するベンチマーク「Unsatz」を提案する。微分方程式や確率過程など80のシミュレーション系において、エージェントは未知の系を予測する能力で評価される。9つのLLMは21〜60%の成功率を示したが、古典的手法が失敗する構造探索の難しさが浮き彫りになった。エージェントは変数の特定は可能だが、相互作用の発見や汎化予測よりも訓練誤差の低減を優先する傾向がある。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と科学発見のベンチマーク評価が関心に直結

papers.title: EMBERS: Empirically Motivated Robustness Testing of Deep Research Systems via Defect-Guided Fuzzing
papers.summary: Deep Research (DR) systems extend large language models into autonomous agents that decompose complex information needs, iteratively search the web, and synthesize evidence to answer challenging questions. However, their multi-stage execution may introduce robustness risks, as variations in user questions or intermediate search inputs may propagate across research stages and lead to incorrect answers. Existing evaluations focus on task-solving capabilities or robustness against external evidence disturbances, leaving intrinsic weaknesses in DR execution insufficiently explored. Thus, we conduct an empirical study of 1,932 execution trajectories from three representative DR systems and identify nine recurring defect categories across subquestion formulation, online search, and final reasoning. Guided by these findings, we propose EMBERS, an empirically motivated, defect-guided fuzzing framework for robustness testing of DR systems. Starting from correctly answered seed questions, EMBERS generates stage-targeted test inputs using defect-guided mutation, web-search-assisted fidelity assurance, and diversity-aware seed maintenance. Experiments across 16 framework--model--dataset settings show that EMBERS achieves 3.21 times the failure-discovery throughput of the strongest baseline under identical testing budgets. Human and LLM-assisted evaluations demonstrate that most generated inputs preserve the original information need and necessary contextual constraints. Moreover, model fine-tuning experiments show consistent-answer performance improvement, highlighting their value for robustness testing and model improvement.
papers.title_ja: EMBERS: 欠陥誘導型ファジングによる深層研究システムの経験的に動機付けられた頑健性テスト
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、Web検索と推論を繰り返す自律エージェント（Deep Researchシステム）の頑健性を評価するフレームワーク「EMBERS」を提案する。1,932件の実行軌跡から9つの欠陥カテゴリを特定し、これらを基にした欠陥誘導型ファジングにより、段階的にターゲットを絞ったテスト入力を生成する手法を開発した。16通りの設定での実験により、既存ベースライン比3.21倍の障害発見スループットを達成し、モデルのファインチューニングによる性能向上も示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計と評価手法・ハルシネーション対策に直結する

papers.title: CaRe-KT: Continuity-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning for Knowledge Tracing
papers.summary: Knowledge tracing (KT) estimates learners' evolving knowledge states from interaction histories to support adaptive learning. Retrieval-augmented KT improves these estimates using cross-learner behavioral evidence, but existing approaches typically separate evidence retrieval from downstream prediction. This creates a retrieval-inference alignment gap because evidence relevance varies with the learner's evolving state and prediction context. We propose CaRe-KT, a query-adaptive framework that maintains relevance continuity between evidence acquisition and inference without equating retrieval relevance with predictive utility. CaRe-KT introduces an Evidence-Graph Cache (EGC) that combines persistent question-level relational compatibility with interaction-level temporal validity to construct query-specific evidence subgraphs. Historical learning trajectories retrieved through these subgraphs are encoded alongside the target learner's history in a shared representation space using outcome-supervised contrastive learning. An attention mechanism combines acquisition relevance with learned query-evidence compatibility, allowing relevance to inform, rather than determine, each trajectory's predictive influence. Experiments across five benchmarks show that CaRe-KT outperforms strong KT baselines and remains robust under sparse-history and cold-start conditions. These findings support relevance continuity as a design principle for retrieval-augmented knowledge tracing.
papers.title_ja: CaRe-KT: 知識トレースのための連続性認識型検索拡張推論
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、学習者の知識状態推定（知識トレース）において、証拠の検索と推論の間に存在する整合性のギャップを解消するフレームワーク「CaRe-KT」を提案する。証拠グラフキャッシュ（EGC）を用いてクエリ固有の証拠サブグラフを構築し、対比学習とアテンション機構を通じて、検索の関連性と予測効用を区別しながら連続的に統合する。5つのベンチマーク実験により、既存のベースラインを上回る性能と、履歴が乏しい状況下での頑健性を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: RAGとエージェント設計、および評価手法への高い関連性

papers.title: Honest Small Decision Models for Finance: Scale, Specialization Collapse, and Mixed-Corpus Remediation
papers.summary: Financial workflows need fast, calibrated, auditable decisions, not just generated text. We train System-1 decision models, small language models fine-tuned to answer typed questions (choice/score/noul) with a probability in a single forward pass, across two model families (K2-Horizon and Qwen3.5/3.8) and nine rungs from 0.8B to 32B parameters, using one frozen LoRA recipe on a public decision benchmark and two new finance corpora: a programmatic-gold policy corpus (rule-reading with exact labels) and a reality-labeled outcome corpus (19,640 realized forward-return questions in walk-forward splits, plus a sealed 2026 test of 1,360 questions). Narrow fine-tuning costs general decision competence 9-45 percentage points, a data-mixture effect that shrinks with model scale and is associated with narrow-gradient volume. On reality-labeled questions, every trained rung from 0.8B to 32B lands at the horizon-conditioned prior baseline (accuracy 0.37-0.38, no detectable conditional edge under our controls); the models respond with flat, well-calibrated probabilities that track per-horizon base rates: naturally honest uncertainty, with a mid-scale calibration sweet spot (ECE 0.026 at 2B, degrading to 0.043-0.044 at 9-32B under prior drift). A mixed-corpus remediation carries all competencies in one adapter at modest cost: it matches or slightly exceeds the generalist specialist on the public benchmark while holding the policy ceiling and near-specialist outcome calibration, yielding a deployable artifact with per-domain temperature regimes and a band-dispatch escalation analysis: sharp, dispatchable bands where rules determine answers; flat, review-routing bands where reality does not.
papers.title_ja: 金融における誠実な小型決定モデル：規模、専門性崩壊、および混合コーパスによる是正
papers.summary_ja: 金融業務向けに、単一フォワードパスで確率付き決定を行う小型LLM（System-1モデル）の設計と評価を行う。0.8B〜32Bパラメータのモデルで、狭い領域へのファインチューニングが汎用決定能力を9〜45ポイント低下させる「専門性崩壊」現象を定量化した。現実データでは全規模がベースラインと同等の精度しか出ず、中規模（2B）で較正誤差が最小となることを示す。混合コーパスによる是正により、汎用性と専門性を両立させる単一アダプタの実現可能性を検証した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM効率化・小型化と実務向け評価手法が関心に直結

papers.title: Language Models Can Benefit from Domain-Specific Inductive Biases
papers.summary: Language models are typically trained with a single choice of architecture on diverse domains and data sources. Modern transformers have been extensively refined for such general-purpose learning, but are they equally effective across different subsets of the pretraining data? We investigate this question by training small language models from scratch on representative subsets of pretraining data such as web text, code, and mathematics. We introduce variants of transformers in which standard activation functions are replaced with learned splines tuned on specific datasets, providing a simple way to modify their inductive biases. Using a mix-and-match of architectures and datasets, we evaluate cross-domain transfer, i.e. how well does an architecture tuned for one domain perform on data from another? We find that the tuned transformer variants improve training efficiency or generalization on all seven of our tested datasets, but the gains are often domain-specific. For example, architectures tuned on a natural language dataset such as FineWeb perform well on TinyStories, whereas those tuned on mathematics perform poorly on natural language. We identify several mechanisms underlying these improvements, including wider loss basins and more abundant "lottery tickets". Our results show that different subsets of pretraining data can benefit from different learning mechanisms, highlighting a limitation of the prevailing trend towards a small set of general-purpose architectures and optimizers. This points to an opportunity to improve data efficiency by developing domain-specific learning strategies that retain the ability to train general-purpose models.
papers.title_ja: ドメイン特異的な帰納的バイアスから言語モデルが恩恵を受ける可能性
papers.summary_ja: 本研究では、Webテキスト・コード・数学などの異なるデータセットで小型言語モデルを訓練し、標準的な活性化関数を学習済みスプラインに置き換えることで帰納的バイアスを調整する手法を提案する。この変種は全7つのテストデータセットで訓練効率や汎化性能を向上させたが、その効果はドメインに依存し、数学で調整したモデルは自然言語では性能が低下する傾向が見られた。損失盆地の広がりや「ロトリーチケット」の増加が改善のメカニズムとして特定され、汎用アーキテクチャ一辺倒の限界と、ドメイン特異的戦略によるデータ効率向上の可能性が示唆されている。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの訓練効率化とアーキテクチャ最適化に直結する手法

papers.title: Dr. No: Feature Steering for Abstention in Vision-Language Models
papers.summary: Large foundation models often answer even when the available visual or textual evidence is insufficient to support a reliable conclusion. This failure to abstain makes them hard to trust in high-stakes or information-seeking settings, where a confident but unsupported answer can be worse than no answer at all. It also raises a natural question: can the internal mechanisms behind this behaviour be identified and controlled at inference time? We present Dr. No, a feature-steering approach that mines sparse autoencoder (SAE) features associated with abstention and commitment, then modulates a small set of them during the prefill pass, without retraining the base model. Dr. No is evaluated on LLaVA-1.6 Mistral 7B across multimodal abstention benchmarks, including UNK-VQA and MM-UPD, and additionally benchmarked on language reasoning tasks using Qwen3.5-2B on AbstentionBench subsets. Against multiple uncertainty-based abstention baselines, feature steering achieves a more favourable balance between correct answering and appropriate abstention than post-hoc rejection methods. The gains are strongest on UNK-VQA and on MM-UPD cases involving image--question or question--answer incompatibility, and transfer most clearly to mathematical reasoning subsets of AbstentionBench. However, performance is more limited on absent-answer detection and retrieval-heavy multi-hop QA, such as MuSiQue. These results suggest that sparse internal features provide lightweight control handles for shaping uncertainty-aware behaviour in foundation models, while also showing that abstention control is source-dependent rather than governed by a single universal signal.
papers.title_ja: Dr. No: 視覚言語モデルにおける棄権のための特徴量ステアリング
papers.summary_ja: 視覚言語モデルが証拠不足時に誤って回答してしまう問題に対し、スパース自動符号化器（SAE）を用いて棄権と確信に関連する内部特徴量を特定し、推論時のプリフィル段階でこれらを調整する手法「Dr. No」を提案する。再学習なしでモデルの挙動を制御し、LLaVA-1.6 Mistral 7B などのモデルにおいて、従来の不確実性ベースの棄権手法よりも正答率と適切な棄権のバランスを向上させることを示した。特に画像と質問の不一致や数学的推論タスクで効果が顕著だが、検索依存型のマルチホップ QA では効果が限定的であることも明らかになった。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMのハルシネーション対策・信頼性向上という関心に直結する手法

papers.title: Embedding Semantic Entropy: NLI-Free Semantic Uncertainty Estimation with Geometry-Aware Clustering
papers.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often generate fluent yet incorrect responses, making un- certainty estimation important for reliable deployment. Semantic Entropy (SE) estimates uncertainty by clustering responses based on semantic equivalence, but it relies on hard entailment-based clustering. We propose Embedding Semantic Entropy, which replaces entailment-based clustering with K-Medoids in semantic embedding space and uses dynamic cluster selection to account for intra-cluster compactness and inter-cluster separation. We evaluate the method on TriviaQA, SQuAD, NQ-Open, SVAMP, and BioASQ using Falcon- 7B-Instruct, LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-7B-Chat, and Gemma-7B. Results show competitive AUROC and AUARC performance, suggesting that NLI-based entailment clustering can be replaced with embedding-space clustering with limited degradation while improving the inspectability of semantic grouping. This matters because semantic uncertainty scores depend on underlying semantic groups; by making these groups explicit, compact, and separable in embedding space, Emb-SE turns uncertainty estimation from a black-box en- tailment decision into an inspectable clustering problem.
papers.title_ja: 埋め込みセマンティックエントロピー：NLI不要な幾何学認識クラスタリングによるセマンティック不確実性推定
papers.summary_ja: 大規模言語モデル（LLM）の出力におけるセマンティック不確実性を推定する手法として、従来のNLI（自然言語推論）ベースのクラスタリングを、埋め込み空間におけるK-Medoidsクラスタリングに置き換える「Embedding Semantic Entropy」を提案する。動的なクラスタ選択により、クラスター内の凝縮度とクラスター間の分離度を考慮し、TrivQAやSQuADなどのベンチマークで既存手法と競合する性能を示した。この手法は、不確実性評価をブラックボックス的な推論判断から、明示的で検証可能なクラスタリング問題へと変換し、LLMの信頼性評価とハルシネーション対策に貢献する。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMの信頼性評価・ハルシネーション対策に直結する手法

papers.title: Forget What Comes Next: LLM Unlearning via Statistical Independence
papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) can memorize and reproduce fragments of their training data, raising privacy and legal concerns that motivate machine unlearning. Yet poisoned training examples can remain statistically detectable after unlearning, which raises the question of whether current unlearning objectives remove what the model has memorized at all. In this work, we introduce PINT, a novel algorithm for machine unlearning that uses the Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion (HSIC) to reduce the statistical dependence between tokens to be forgotten and the internal representations used to predict them. We formally relate our HSIC-based objective to Exact Memorization through a computable upper bound, connecting the training objective directly to the model's ability to reproduce the forgotten tokens. In extensive experiments, we compare forgetting-utility trade-offs across eight settings with models up to 7B parameters and demonstrate scalability to 70B parameter models. Our evaluations cover unlearning Gaussian poisons, personal information, hazardous knowledge in biology and cybersecurity, and copyrighted books and news articles. PINT achieves the strongest forgetting-utility trade-off on average and is the only method to make Gaussian poisons undetectable while maintaining near-original model utility. Code is available at: https://github.com/shkabrii/PINT
papers.title_ja: 次に来るものを忘れる：統計的独立性によるLLMのアンラーニング
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、大規模言語モデル（LLM）のアンラーニング手法として、Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion (HSIC) を用いて忘却対象トークンと内部表現間の統計的依存性を低減するアルゴリズム「PINT」を提案する。HSIC ベースの目的関数と完全記憶（Exact Memorization）の間に計算可能な上界を導出し、モデルが忘却トークンを再生成する能力と訓練目標を形式的に結びつけた。最大70B パラメータのモデルを用いた広範な実験により、プライバシー情報や有害知識の忘却において、他の手法より優れた「忘却-有用性」トレードオフを実現し、ガウス型ポイズンを検出不能にする唯一の方法であることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM の安全性・プライバシー対策として実務応用可能な高度なアンラーニング手法

papers.title: WASP-Mem: Let Agent Organize Procedural Memory. Human Spend Effort on Diagnosis
papers.summary: LLM agents struggle to automate complex enterprise procedures because static, pre-built harness cannot capture proprietary policies, undocumented behaviors, or state-dependent recovery paths that surface only during execution. Procedural memory accrued from agent experience offers a training-free path to closing this gap -- yet unlike episodic records or semantic facts, it must consolidate repeated successes and diagnosed failures into reusable actions and recovery strategies. We introduce WASP-Mem (Wiki-based Agent-Synthesized Procedural Memory), a nimble but effective method that distills execution traces and feedback into persistent, interlinked wiki pages, enabling continual agent learning. On TheAgentCompany benchmark, WASP-Mem raises the checkpoint pass rate by 4.6-6.1% over the strongest baseline we compared across three models while requiring 57-61% less storage. We further present a systematic controlled study spanning consolidation method, feedback type, trace ingestion scope, and refinement rounds. Our results reveal that prescriptive knowledge organization such as human defined schemas and explicit deduplication rules hurts performance rather than closing the procedural-knowledge gap. In contrast, human diagnosis converts failed traces into corrective knowledge and drives sustained improvement: a single round of human diagnosis outperforms four rounds of self-judgment by 7.0-10.9%. These findings point to a simple division of labor: let agents organize procedural memory, and invest human effort where it matters most -- diagnosis.
papers.title_ja: WASP-Mem: エージェントが手続き的記憶を整理し、人間は診断に労力を割く
papers.summary_ja: LLMエージェントが企業内の複雑な手続きを自動化する際、静的な設定では対応できない状態依存の回復パスを学習させるための手法「WASP-Mem」を提案する。実行トレースとフィードバックを相互リンクされたWikiページとして統合し、訓練なしでエージェントの継続的学習を可能にする。TheAgentCompanyベンチマークにおいて、最強ベースライン比でチェックポイントパス率を4.6〜6.1%向上させ、かつストレージ使用量を57〜61%削減した。さらに、人間による失敗トレースの診断が自己判断より大幅に有効であり、エージェントが記憶を整理し人間が診断に集中する役割分担が最適であることが示された。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計とRAG的記憶管理の効率化に直結する手法

papers.title: Decision Transformer with Task-Aware Representations for Offline Meta-Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: To enable effective generalization in offline meta-RL, it is essential to accurately infer the underlying task through latent task representations, which provide a compact and transferable summary of task-specific characteristics for guiding policy generation. In this paper, we propose Contrastive Task-Aware Decision Transformer (CoTA-DT), a DT-based offline meta-RL framework that learns task representations by jointly integrating four complementary components: (i) contrastive learning from offline trajectories, (ii) alignment with natural-language task descriptions, (iii) one-step supervision via a task-conditioned world model, and (iv) long-term supervision via a task-conditioned Q function. The learned task representations are used as conditioning signals for a DT-based policy, enabling task-aware meta-policy learning. To further support generalization in both zero-shot and few-shot settings, we design a language-grounded, self-adaptive strategy that enables effective and reliable adaptation to unseen tasks. Notably, in CoTA-DT, the pretrained LLM serves as a shared backbone for language encoding, world modeling, Q-function estimation, and policy learning. This unified design facilitates parameter sharing, improving both efficiency and generalization. Extensive experiments across diverse offline meta-RL benchmarks demonstrate that CoTA-DT consistently outperforms prior methods, particularly in challenging zero-shot generalization scenarios.
papers.title_ja: オフラインメタ強化学習のためのタスク認識表現を用いた決定変換器
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、オフラインメタ強化学習におけるタスク推論と汎化性能を向上させるためのフレームワーク「CoTA-DT」を提案する。対比学習、自然言語説明との整合、タスク条件付きワールドモデルおよびQ関数による監督信号を統合し、コンパクトなタスク表現を学習する。事前学習済みLLMを言語エンコーディングからポリシー学習まで共有バックボーンとして活用することで、パラメータ共有を通じた効率化とゼロショット・フューショット設定での汎化能力を両立させる。多様なベンチマークにおいて、特に困難なゼロショット汎化シナリオで既存手法を上回る性能を実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習とLLM統合、効率化・汎化への貢献が関心に合致

papers.title: Language Model Augmented Decision Transformer for Multi-Task Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Offline multi-task reinforcement learning (MTRL) aims to learn a unified policy from heterogeneous offline datasets that generalizes across tasks. However, existing offline MTRL methods often struggle with two fundamental issues: severe per-task data scarcity and limited cross-task generalization. In this paper, we propose Language-Model Augmented Decision Transformer (LaMA-DT), a unified sequence-modeling framework that leverages a single large language model (LLM) for both trajectory augmentation and multi-task policy learning. LaMA-DT uses natural-language task descriptions to guide task-aligned trajectory augmentation through a set of supervised generation and alignment objectives, and incorporates a scoring-and-filtering mechanism to retain high-quality augmented trajectories. The same LLM is then repurposed as a language-conditioned Decision Transformer and fine-tuned on a mixture of real and augmented data. Experiments on Meta-World and MuJoCo multi-task benchmarks demonstrate that LaMA-DT consistently outperforms competitive baselines, particularly in low-data regimes, showing that language-guided data augmentation substantially improves cross-task generalization.
papers.title_ja: マルチタスクオフライン強化学習のための言語モデル拡張決定変換器
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、オフラインマルチタスク強化学習におけるデータ不足と汎化性能の低さを解決するため、大規模言語モデル（LLM）を活用したLaMA-DTを提案する。LLMを用いて自然言語のタスク説明に基づき軌道を拡張し、スコアリングとフィルタリングにより高品質なデータを抽出する。さらに、同じLLMを言語条件付き決定変換器として再利用し、実データと拡張データの混合でファインチューニングを行う。Meta-WorldやMuJoCoでの実験により、特に低データ環境でのクロスタスク汎化性能が既存手法を上回ることが示された。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMと強化学習の融合、オフラインRLの効率化という関心に直結する手法。

papers.title: ExaTune: Exhaustive Hyperparameter Landscape Exploration at Scale
papers.summary: Hyperparameter optimization (HPO) returns a single optimal configuration, systematically discarding the explored performance landscape that encodes how results depend on configuration choices. Fitness landscape analysis comprises a robust collection of methods from evolutionary computation offering ruggedness indices, autocorrelation functions, and fitness-distance correlation that have never been applied to machine learning hyperparameter spaces at scale, given that fine-grained ground-truth enumeration data has not existed. We present ExaTune, an open-source HPC system to produce a new artifact class: the hyperparameter landscape map. ExaTune exhaustively evaluates every point on a discretized hyperparameter grid via $K$-fold cross-validation, aggregates results into reproducible parquet benchmarks, and applies a suite of five formalized landscape metrics: spatial autocorrelation (Moran's $I$), ruggedness, local optima density, fitness-distance correlation (FDC), and variance-based parameter importance. We release a benchmark collection of 8 complete landscape maps (totalling 285,080 exhaustively evaluated configurations) spanning five model families (SVMs, random forests, XGBoost, ridge regression, and $k$-nearest neighbors) across six classification and two regression benchmarks, hosted on HuggingFace. Empirical analysis demonstrates that Bayesian optimization, Optuna, Hyperband, and Random Search at standard trial budgets systematically miss instability regions, secondary optima, and parameter interaction effects that are visible in complete landscapes; information that is structurally unavailable to any optimizer by design.
papers.title_ja: ExaTune: 大規模なハイパーパラメータ景観の網羅的探索
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、機械学習のハイパーパラメータ最適化（HPO）において、単一の最適解だけでなく、離散化されたグリッド上の全点を網羅的に評価し、ハイパーパラメータ空間の「景観マップ」を生成するHPCシステムExaTuneを提案する。空間自己相関、粗さ、局所最適解密度などの5つの指標を用いて、ベイズ最適化やランダムサーチでは捉えきれない不安定領域やパラメータ間の相互作用を可視化する。SVMやXGBoostなど5つのモデルファミリーに対する8つの完全な景観マップ（約28.5万設定）を公開し、既存の最適化手法が構造的に欠落させる情報を定量的に示した。
papers.relevance_reason: ベイズ最適化の限界とML手法の網羅的評価が関心に直結

papers.title: When Latent Dynamics Meet Data Assimilation: A Benchmark of Koopman-Type Representations
papers.summary: Koopman representations describe nonlinear dynamics through linear evolution in a transformed space, offering an attractive framework for their linear simplicity and generality. Yet these advantages do not necessarily translate into improved performance in deep latent data assimilation (LDA). We systematically compare seven representative methods and structural baselines across five systems spanning approximately periodic to strongly chaotic dynamics and a broad range of state dimensions. We evaluate forecast and assimilation accuracy, physical state recovery, latent-trajectory behavior, and dynamical consistency, and assess Gaussian error assumptions, objective convexity, and uniqueness of analysis solutions. Our results reveal a trade-off between representational flexibility and optimization tractability. Linear evolution of the latent state can stabilize short-term forecasts but restrict expressiveness in strongly chaotic and high-dimensional systems, without consistently improving assimilation accuracy. Parameterized linear operators offer greater flexibility, yet their joint optimization with the encoder--decoder remains nonconvex. Methods with closed-form analysis updates generally perform better and exhibit greater robustness in our experiments, although matrix inversion remains a computational bottleneck. These findings show that the practical benefits of Koopman structure depend on both sufficient observational information and the choice of assimilation procedure.
papers.title_ja: 潜在ダイナミクスとデータ同化の出会い：Koopman型表現のベンチマーク
papers.summary_ja: Koopman表現を用いた深層潜在データ同化（LDA）において、7つの代表的な手法と5つの系（周期的から強カオス的まで）で系統的な比較評価を行った。予測精度、同化精度、物理状態の復元、および最適化の凸性などを多角的に分析した結果、表現の柔軟性と最適化の扱いやすさのトレードオフが明らかになった。線形進化は短期予測を安定させるが、高次元カオス系では表現力が制限され、同化精度の向上には一貫して寄与しないことが示された。閉形式の解析更新を持つ手法が一般的に高性能かつ頑健である一方、行列逆行列計算が計算ボトルネックとなることも確認された。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルとデータ同化のベンチマークであり、ML手法の評価に直結

papers.title: P$^2$-MOPD: Accelerating Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation via Parameter Priors
papers.summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation consolidates expert capabilities by supervising student-generated trajectories, whereas task arithmetic offers a training-free alternative through linear parameter combinations. We view the linear combination of student and expert parameters as a single differentiable model and propose P$^2$-MOPD, which jointly optimizes the mixing coefficients and the student weights under the same on-policy distillation objective. Unlike task arithmetic, which stays within the span of the frozen student and expert parameters for any choice of merging coefficients, P$^2$-MOPD keeps the student trainable, so the experts act as parameter priors without confining it to this span. Across four domains at 1.7B and 4B scales, P$^2$-MOPD achieves faster and more balanced recovery than MOPD from the same initialization, surpassing its final average recovery in half the training steps. At the end of training, our 1.7B model reaches 94.7% average recovery, versus 80.9% for MOPD.
papers.title_ja: P$^2$-MOPD: パラメータ事前分布によるマルチティーチャ・オンポリシー蒸留の高速化
papers.summary_ja: マルチティーチャ・オンポリシー蒸留とタスク算術を統合し、混合係数と学生モデルの重みを同時に最適化する新手法 P$^2$-MOPD を提案する。従来のタスク算術が固定パラメータの線形結合空間に閉じ込められるのに対し、本手法は学生モデルを訓練可能に保ち、エキスパートをパラメータ事前分布として活用することで表現空間を拡張する。1.7B と 4B スケールの 4 ドメインで検証し、既存手法より高速かつバランスの取れた性能回復を実現した。最終的に 1.7B モデルで平均 94.7% の回復率を達成し、既存手法の 80.9% を大きく上回った。
papers.relevance_reason: LLM の蒸留・効率化・推論高速化に直結する手法

papers.title: Efficient Identification and Analysis of Space debris Trails in Time-Domain Astronomy
papers.summary: This paper presents an automated end-to-end pipeline to detect and characterize artificial satellites and space debris streaks. As the exponential rise of orbital debris poses an escalating risk to global space assets, providing scalable, real-time tools is a critical contribution to the global Space Situational Awareness (SSA) network. The architecture utilizes a multi-stage geometric approach for raw image segmentation and high-precision morphological characterization. Experimental results demonstrate robust performance in real-world survey environments, successfully recovering streak profiles with an operational detection limit for features with integrated $SNR \ge 86$ and lengths $\ge 98$ arcseconds. This unsupervised framework strengthens global space sustainability efforts by monitoring RSO populations.
papers.title_ja: 時間領域天文学における宇宙デブリ軌跡の効率的な特定と解析
papers.summary_ja: 人工衛星や宇宙デブリのストリーク（軌跡）を自動検出・特徴量抽出するエンドツーエンドのパイプラインを提案する。生画像のセグメンテーションと高精度な形態論的特徴量解析のための多段階幾何学的アプローチを採用している。実世界の観測環境で、統合SNR 86以上かつ長さ98角秒以上の特徴量を検出できることを示し、宇宙状況認識（SSA）ネットワークへの貢献を強調している。
papers.relevance_reason: 宇宙機関連だが、軌道力学やML手法より画像処理・検出に特化

papers.title: Probabilistic Steering of Generative Priors for Lab-in-the-Loop Antibody Optimization
papers.summary: Therapeutic antibody development is often framed as comprising two discrete stages: initial discovery of novel binders followed by iterative optimization to refine these hits into therapeutic-grade molecules. Models and methods often reflect these stages, with generative structure models applied to discovery and probabilistic black-box optimization methods applied to refinement. Here we propose to unify these stages by smoothly transitioning a generative discovery model into iterative optimization, allowing the handoff between the structure-based prior and supervision from wet lab data to be guided by the posterior uncertainty of a probabilistic surrogate. We show that this yields improvements in optimization efficiency in the low-N regime, as well as improved diversity amongst the optimized molecules.
papers.title_ja: 実験室フィードバックループによる抗体最適化のための生成事前分布の確率的ステアリング
papers.summary_ja: 抗体発見と最適化の段階を統合し、生成モデルから確率的サロゲートモデルによる反復最適化へスムーズに移行する手法を提案する。事後不確実性を活用して構造ベースの事前分布とウェットラボデータからの監督信号を制御することで、低サンプル数環境での最適化効率と分子多様性を向上させる。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルとベイズ最適化の活用は関心領域だが、対象が抗体であり軌道力学ではないため中程度。

papers.title: Decomposing Rank Reversals under Temporal Nonstationarity: Alignment, Aggressiveness, and Instability
papers.summary: Under temporal nonstationarity, model performance rankings reverse across training horizons due to heterogeneous sensitivities to memory. While existing literature addresses adaptive lookbacks, effective model complexity, and empirical forecast evaluation in isolation, no unified framework explains the structural mechanics driving these rank reversals. We bridge this gap by deriving a model-agnostic decomposition of out-of-sample $R^2$ into target alignment, miscalibrated aggressiveness, and predictive instability. Within this framework, we mathematically characterize complexity phase boundaries, establish closed-form optimal-memory equations for ridge regression under local drift, and extend these guarantees to complex model architectures via surrogate bounds. We validate these theoretical dynamics by benchmarking 14 linear, tree-based, and neural architectures across large-scale financial panels. In doing so, our framework demonstrates that empirical model rank reversals are driven by predictable surges in miscalibrated aggressiveness, providing a rigorous mechanistic diagnosis of generalization under temporal shift.
papers.title_ja: 時間的非定常性下でのランク逆転の分解：アライメント、アグレッシブネス、不安定性
papers.summary_ja: 時間的非定常性下でモデルの性能ランキングが逆転する現象を、ターゲットアライメント、キャリブレーション不良なアグレッシブネス、予測不安定性の3要素に分解するモデル非依存フレームワークを提案する。リッジ回帰における最適メモリ長の閉形式解を導出するとともに、複雑なモデルアーキテクチャへの適用をサロゲート境界を通じて保証する。金融パネルデータを用いた14種の線形・ツリーベース・ニューラルアーキテクチャのベンチマークにより、理論的動態を実証し、一般化のメカニズムを診断する。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲート境界とモデル評価手法を含むが、主眼は金融予測であり軌道力学とは無関係

papers.title: Nearly Linear-Time Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader for Weakly Observable Graph Bandits
papers.summary: We study online learning with directed weakly observable feedback graphs and propose a Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader (FTPL) policy that achieves best-of-both-worlds guarantee with nearly linear expected time complexity. To preserve the simple structure of FTPL, we develop a novel graph-based loss estimator that combines forced exploration, conditional geometric resampling and adaptive learning rates with surrogate probabilities. Our policy achieves $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\delta_*^{1/3} T^{2/3})$ regret for adversarial regimes as well as $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\delta_* \log T / \Delta_{\min}^2)$ regret for stochastic regimes, where $\delta_*$ and $\Delta$, respectively, denote the fractional weak domination number and the suboptimality gap. These results show that refined guarantees for problems with minimax regret of $\Theta(T^{2/3})$ can be obtained through appropriately designed adaptive learning rates and loss estimators without sacrificing the simplicity of FTPL.
papers.title_ja: 弱観測可能グラフバンディットにおけるほぼ線形時間のFollow-the-Perturbed-Leader
papers.summary_ja: 有向グラフバンディットにおけるオンライン学習問題を対象に、Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader (FTPL) ポリシーの計算効率を改善する手法を提案する。強制探索や条件付き幾何学的再サンプリングを組み合わせた新しいグラフベース損失推定器を設計し、FTPL の単純な構造を保ちながら期待計算時間をほぼ線形に抑えた。敵対的設定と確率的設定の両方で、既存の最小最大後悔限界に近い保証を達成しつつ、適応学習率と損失推定器の最適化による性能向上を示した。

papers.title: Adaptive Low-Rank Quantum Kernel Acquisition under Finite-Shot Measurements: Perturbation Guarantees for QSVMs
papers.summary: Quantum kernel methods require estimating entries of a dense Gram matrix through repeated circuit measurements, making kernel construction expensive and statistically noisy. For a dataset of size $n$, dense construction requires $O(n^2)$ kernel queries, while existing approximation methods typically assume inexpensive access to kernel entries or use non-adaptive sampling. We study adaptive low-rank quantum kernel acquisition when the kernel is accessible only through a finite-shot quantum overlap oracle. Our framework, ICAQKL, uses residual-driven incomplete Cholesky construction to acquire informative kernel columns sequentially and form a positive-semidefinite rank-$r$ surrogate, reducing the training-kernel acquisition cost to $O(nrN_s)$ circuit executions for $r\ll n$, where $N_s$ is the number of shots per queried entry. The central difficulty is that finite-shot errors perturb both the queried kernel values and the adaptive pivot sequence that determines the low-rank factor. We develop a non-asymptotic perturbation framework for this stochastic adaptive process, establishing concentration over the realized queries, stability of noisy pivot selection and factor construction, and propagation of the coupled sampling and approximation errors to the QSVM objective, optimizer, prediction function, and classification margin. The resulting rank--shot conditions characterize when ICAQKL approaches the full QSVM induced by the same quantum feature map. Experiments on benchmark and biomedical datasets show favorable accuracy--query-cost tradeoffs, competitive performance with the full QSVM, and competitive or improved performance relative to the evaluated Nystr\"om baselines under comparable settings. ICAQKL is intended to enable measurement-efficient and theoretically controlled use of a selected quantum kernel, rather than to establish quantum advantage over classical kernels.
papers.title_ja: 有限ショット測定下での適応型低ランク量子カーネル取得：QSVMのための摂動保証
papers.summary_ja: 量子カーネル法における高コストなグラム行列の推定問題を解決するため、残差駆動型の不完全コレスキー分解を用いた適応型低ランク近似フレームワーク「ICAQKL」を提案する。有限ショット測定によるノイズが適応的なピボット選択や低ランク因子の構築に与える影響を考慮した、非漸近的な摂動解析フレームワークを構築した。これにより、サンプリング誤差と近似誤差がQSVMの目的関数や分類マージンにどのように伝播するかを理論的に保証し、完全なQSVMに近づくためのランクとショット数の条件を導出した。ベンチマークおよびバイオメディカルデータセットでの実験により、精度とクエリコストのトレードオフが優れており、Nyströmベースラインと比較しても競争力のある性能を示すことを確認した。
